scope: 75-second shallow sample only; no persistent population or catalogue size migration
assetSource: Original project-authored Three.js geometry and vertex surface colours; no third-party mesh or photograph was copied into this kit.
limits: Species silhouettes and colours are authored interpretations of museum and agency descriptions, not digitised measured outlines or specimen scans.
Body and fin frequencies are bounded display animation, not calibrated locomotion or a fluid simulation.
No claim of documentary photorealism, actual browser/GPU acceptance or natural colour calibration follows from native geometry checks.
